product.title: Private Yellowstone Wildlife Tour in the American Serengeti

description.text: Explore Yellowstone's Lamar Valley and Hayden Valley on a private wildlife tour nicknamed the American Serengeti. Your guide uses spotting scopes at dawn-active corridors and routes through Mammoth Hot Springs and Norris Geyser Basin when wildlife activity slows midday.

highlights: Private wildlife safari in Lamar and Hayden valleys
Spotting scopes for wolf and bear viewing
Mammoth Hot Springs thermal terrace stop
Norris Geyser Basin boardwalk when routing allows
Expert guide with recent park sighting intel

start.description: Early morning pickup from West Yellowstone hotels for Lamar Valley wildlife runs.

end.description: Return to West Yellowstone after afternoon wildlife scanning in Hayden Valley.

itineraryItems.title: Lamar Valley
itineraryItems.description: Primary wildlife drive through Lamar Valley's open meadows and river bends.

itineraryItems.title: Hayden Valley
itineraryItems.description: Afternoon bison and elk viewing in Hayden Valley grasslands.

itineraryItems.title: Mammoth Hot Springs
itineraryItems.description: Thermal terrace walk at Mammoth Hot Springs between wildlife sessions.

itineraryItems.title: Norris Geyser Basin
itineraryItems.description: Optional Norris Geyser Basin boardwalk when wildlife activity is quiet.

faqs.question: How long is the Private Yellowstone Wildlife Tour in the American Serengeti?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 7 to 8 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from in Yellowstone National Park?
faqs.answer: Early morning pickup from West Yellowstone hotels for Lamar Valley wildlife runs.
